anticipos.intro: Asking for a deposit takes no-shows from one in five appointments down to almost none. It is applied in full to the service on the day of the visit.

anticipos.audienceNEWHint: Anyone who has never completed a visit with you.
anticipos.audienceNO_SHOWHint: The fairest one and the best received: it does not punish clients who always show up.
anticipos.refundWindowHint: After that moment the deposit is not refunded. 0 = never refunded.

anticipos.onlineHint: When booking, the client pays by card through Stripe secure checkout.
